message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules** | Item | Description | |------|-------------| | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue). Each color has numbers 0‑9 (two of each except one 0) and two of each action card: Skip, Reverse, Draw Two. Additionally, there are 4 Wild cards and 4 Wild Draw Four cards. | | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are earned when you finish a round by discarding all your cards. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, apply its effect immediately. | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a Reverse card changes direction). | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play **one** card that matches either the color, number, or symbol of the top card on the discard pile. If you have no playable card, you must draw one from the draw pile. If that drawn card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Changes play direction.
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – You choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – You choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. (Can only be played if you have no other playable card; otherwise, you can be challenged.) | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you discard your second‑to‑last card, you must say “UNO.” If another player catches you not saying it, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards remaining in opponents’ hands: numbered cards = face value, action cards = 20 points, Wild cards = 50 points. | | **Winning the Game** | The first player to reach the target score (usually 500) wins. | --- ### Common Variations | Variation | What It Changes | |-----------|-----------------| | **Stacking** | If a player has a matching Draw Two or Wild Draw Four, they can stack it on the previous one, forcing the next player to draw the cumulative amount unless they also stack. | | **No Challenge** | Some groups allow Wild Draw Four to be played freely without the “no other playable card” rule. | | **Custom Decks** | Players can add extra Wild cards or create themed decks. | | **House Rules** | e.g., “Draw Two” can be played on any card, “Reverse” can be played on any card, etc. | --- ### Quick Play Summary 1. **Deal** 7 cards each. 2. **Start** with the top card of the draw pile. 3. **Play** a matching card or draw. 4. **Use** action cards to affect the next player. 5. **Call UNO** when you’re down to one card. 6. **Finish** the round when someone discards all cards. 7. **Score** and continue until someone reaches the target score. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
